notes: image::jpeg: a port of Go's decoder and encoder. Decode reads baseline, extended and progressive JPEGs (restart markers, all standard and Go 1.27 flex sampling ratios, grayscale, YCbCr, RGB, Adobe CMYK/YCCK) with Go's IDCT, leniencies and error texts, and returns Box<dyn Image> holding Gray, Ycbcr, Rgba or Cmyk; Encode is byte-identical to Go for every input image type; FormatError/UnsupportedError are payloads of io::Error; registered with image::decode as "jpeg". Go panics on a few malformed inputs (a Huffman table that indexes outside its values, a block outside its plane); the Rust decoder returns a FormatError instead

Decode.note: Go panics on a malformed Huffman table or an out-of-plane block; Rust returns a FormatError. The optional Limits budget (unlimited by default) is rust_stdlib::image::jpeg::decode_with_limits

Encode.note: the options argument is Option<&Options>, Go's nil *Options; the output is buffered through Go's 4096-byte bufio.Writer chunking

FormatError.note: a tuple struct; the decoder returns it as the payload of an io::Error of kind InvalidData

Reader.note: io.ByteReader plus io.Reader is std::io::BufRead; the deprecated interface is unused by the package

UnsupportedError.note: a tuple struct; returned as the payload of an io::Error of kind Unsupported
